items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Sidney Dersween once had the Maple Leaf band.

ctx.x: Talk to me now. What about Sidney Dersween? Who did he play with? You mentioned him before the machine was on.
Sidney Dersween once had the Maple Leaf band. Oh, yeah. Then after he had his own band, he always had the band behind his, maybe he had his own band. He had the band.
Well, we haven't covered about half of it yet. About to run. What about a ratchet stick? You want me to tell me about a ratchet stick?
